options.name: Molten Cartography
options.story_approach: The song becomes an evolving abstract map whose strata, fault lines and contour pressure expose hidden depth without literal lyric illustration.
options.rendering_route: Deterministic HTML/WebGL/canvas-style reactive contour fields, liquid-metal sheets, moire interference, bounded parallax and music-anchored transitions.

storyboard.description: A nearly black plane reveals a few pearl contour lines as the song wakes.
Measured surges force new strata upward; fault lines split and rejoin without becoming recognizable objects.
The middle plateau becomes a deep layered map with slow orthographic drift and audio-reactive interference.
Late surges compress the field into a central seam, then reopen it into broad coherent plates.
At the terminal drop the map sheds layers until one residual line dissolves into black.

options.name: Signal Cathedral
options.story_approach: The music constructs and deconstructs a vast nonliteral architecture of light, negative space and impossible scale.
options.rendering_route: Deterministic geometric volumes, volumetric light bands, restrained camera pushes and shader transitions synchronized to measured audio anchors.

storyboard.description: Thin luminous planes establish an impossible empty chamber.
Rhythmic events assemble columns and spans from pure geometry rather than real-world architecture.
The main plateau reveals huge nested voids while the camera moves only on explicit axes.
Late drops remove structural layers and expose a final suspended plane.
The last plane extinguishes into featureless black.

options.name: Ash Astronomy
options.story_approach: The song unfolds as an invented celestial system made of dust, orbital traces and gravitational interference, with no literal starscape narrative.
options.rendering_route: Procedural particle fields, orbital linework, lens-like warps, depth layers and measured energy-driven density changes.

storyboard.description: Sparse particles and one orbital trace emerge from black.
Transient clusters form temporary constellations that immediately dissolve.
The sustained middle section develops nested orbital shells and gravitational lensing.
Late surges collapse several shells into one dense rotating field.
The terminal drop releases the particles outward and leaves a dark empty frame.

user_selection.selection_interpretation: Current user explicitly instructed uninterrupted continuation; the director selected option 1 rather than pausing production for another invitation.
